selection.sm_limit: 1 CTA, or one 2-CTA cluster when the algorithm uses CGA

notes: Hopper 0.6.17 public APIs only; Blackwell-only paths are excluded.
RoPE/ALiBi/custom_mask cases use backend=fa2 because FA3 rejects those features.
Ragged cases include unequal lengths; paged cases include non-contiguous page indices.
Decode covers SIMT, tensor-core, and Hopper XQA (bf16 KV and SM90 fp8 KV); FA3 decode is explicit.
Segment GEMM uses real weight_indices routing; fused MoE is single-GPU CUTLASS (tp=ep=1).
Fused MoE includes SM90 mixed-input W4A16 MXFP4 and W4A8 INT4 via use_w4_group_scaling; not Blackwell NVFP4.
Short kernels are eligible; 100k-cycle and 128-SM occupancy filters are not applied.
This 100-case set is not globaltimer-qualified. Historical measurements stay in reference/.
Coverage is the explicit public-API mechanisms on each case, not shared JIT cache or SASS file counts.
Shared FLASHINFER_WORKSPACE_BASE is a compiled-module closure; other cases' cached kernels are not this case's execution.

Excluded: blackwell_only:trtllm-gen, blackwell_only:cute-dsl, blackwell_only:nvfp4, blackwell_only:sm100_fused_moe, multi_gpu_distributed, flashattention_fa3_standalone, historical_single_sm_entrypoints
